svg.font-family: Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Interference-lithography beam geometries projected on the x–z plane
svg.desc: Three x–z projections of interference-lithography beams: two beams at ±30° refracting into a resist of index 1.6 with the transverse wavevector equal on both sides of the interface, three beams at azimuths 0°, 120° and 240° (hexagonal lattice), and a central beam plus a 60° umbrella (3-D lattice).
svg.text: (a) two beams — 1-D grating; n drops out
E out of the plane (TE, ∥ y)
ideal infinite plane waves; no Fresnel coefficients, no substrate reflection
